paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: The figure is a single-series vertical bar chart titled "QAdapter" illustrating GPU memory usage for several fine-tuning approaches. The horizontal axis contains the method categories (rotated, italicized labels) in the displayed left-to-right order: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, Q-Adapter, and Ours. The vertical value axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale with tick marks shown at 0, 20, 40, and 60 GB, extending to roughly the mid-70 GB range. There are six individual bars: Full FT is an orange bar reaching approximately 73 GB; MTL-FT is orange at about 43 GB; TAG is orange at about 19 GB; Adapter is orange at about 16–17 GB; Q-Adapter is orange at about 8–9 GB; and Ours is a green bar at about 19 GB. The bars are not stacked or grouped, no legend is shown, and the final category (Ours) is visually emphasized by a distinct green color and heavier label styling compared with the preceding orange baseline bars.
